new_lead.title: NASA 2027 RASC-AL Competition
verified_facts: NASA is accepting concepts from U.S.-based collegiate teams for the 2027 RASC-AL competition.
A non-binding notice of intent is due October 13, 2026.
Proposals and accompanying video submissions are due February 24, 2027.
Up to 14 finalist teams may advance to the final phase.
Each finalist team receives a $7,500 award to facilitate participation.
Finalists present at the RASC-AL Forum in Cocoa Beach, Florida, June 7-10, 2027.
The top two overall teams receive an additional monetary award and an invitation to present at an aerospace conference later in 2027.
new_lead.entry_cost: No entry fee was identified in the reviewed NASA announcement; travel and participation costs beyond the finalist award require verification from the full competition guidelines.
